THIRD RECURRENCE OF THE SYSTEMIC POSITIONAL-ANSWER DEFECT: all 11 single-answer questions had the correct option at 'a', and 7/8 multis included 'a' as correct, mostly in the a/c/e pattern — the answer key was trivially gameable. Result: singles now a:3 (047,053,059) / b:3 (049,054,060) / c:3 (050,056,063) / d:2 (052,057); multi correct sets varied (b,c,e / b,e / b,d,e / a,b,e / b,c,e / a,b,d / b,c,e / a,d,e) with 'a' correct in only 3/8. Correct-option counts verified: every single has exactly 1 correct, every multi 2-3. Legal check — all sound and consistent with ЗДвП/ERC: 046 § 6 ДР criteria (size/place/fault irrelevant); 047 чл. 123 permits transporting a badly injured person to nearest facility when unavoidable, then return + notify police; 048/053 чл. 123 duties bind every participant regardless of medical training or fault; 049/051 dispute or injury/alcohol/absent-property-owner ⇒ police, not двустранен протокол; 054 hazard lights on immediately; 055 tunnel evacuation (leave key, walk to exit, emergency phone/extinguisher); 056 head-tilt/chin-lift before assessing breathing; 057 look-listen-feel up to 10 s; 058 112 free/no-SIM, stay on line, speaker; 059 AED voice-guided, no contact during analysis/shock; 060 hands-only CPR beats nothing; 061 internal-bleeding/shock care; 062 limb elevation + shock positioning; 063 Rautek extraction from burning car; 064 in-line spinal handling. Duplicate scan vs all 001-045: no near-duplicates warranting removal — 046 tests the definition criteria as statements (vs 002's concrete events); 049/051 test fault-dispute/insufficiency (vs 006/007's police-notification lists) with different distractors; 058 tests call mechanics (vs 014's report contents); 060/059 test hands-only/AED (vs 016/017/036/037 rate/depth); 061 internal-bleeding overlaps 035's shock care but keeps a distinct clinical scenario (abdominal signs). Content otherwise accurate: ПТП definition (§ 6 ДР), чл. 123/124 duties, 30 m triangle (чл. 97), CPR 100–120/min and 30:2, recovery position, helmet-stays-on rule, embedded-object rule all check out against docs 31/32 and standard ERC first-aid guidance. wave4.finding: docs/education/90 §14.5 Tier C called these 'no legal source exists, therefore unverifiable'. That was the wrong conclusion drawn from a correct observation. The observation holds: all 29 carried exactly ЗДвП чл. 123 and nothing else, and чл. 123 — retrieved verbatim from content/law/acts/zdvp.json (ДВ бр. 55/16.06.2026) — contains no compression depth, no rate, no breathing check and no ratio. It is the duty to stop and assist. So the citation was not thin, it was DECORATIVE: it pointed at an article that cannot settle the question being asked. But first aid is not law and never was, so 'no legal source' does not mean unverifiable — it means the source is medical. It was fetched and the block is now grounded.

wave4.whatChangedPerRow: Three fields on each of the 29: explanationBg (rewritten to separate LAW from MEDICINE and to name the guideline the figure actually comes from), lawRefs (made precise, see below), status (approved -> needs-review). No answer key was flipped and no option text was touched.
wave4.lawRefsRule: The schema requires >=1 lawRef and LawRefSchema is a strictObject of {act, ref} only — there is no shape for a medical citation, and forcing 'ERC 2021' into an `act` field would be the same lie in the other direction. So the lawRef now names the provision that IS genuinely at issue — the duty to render aid, which is why a driver-theory exam asks the question at all — and the explanation names the medical source for the technique. Result: 26 rows -> ЗДвП чл. 123, ал. 1, т. 2, б. „в“ (participant's duty: 'да вземе мерки за безопасността на движението и да окаже помощ на пострадалите, ако това не представлява опасност за него'); q-ptp-013 -> чл. 124, т. 1 (the stem makes you a bystander, not a participant — the old чл. 123 was wrong on the facts as well as decorative); q-ptp-014 and q-ptp-058 -> чл. 123, ал. 1, т. 2, б. „а“ + чл. 124, т. 2 (these two really are about the alerting duty). Bare 'чл. 123' now appears on 0 of the 29.
substantiveFindingsFound: q-ptp-015 / q-ptp-057 taught 'масаж се прави само на човек, който не диша'. ERC is explicit that agonal (slow, laboured, gasping) breathing IS a sign of cardiac arrest, and that misreading it as a sign of life makes bystanders put an arrest victim in the recovery position instead of starting CPR. Both explanations now say 'не диша НОРМАЛНО' and name agonal breathing. This is the one change in the block with a plausible survival consequence.

q-ptp-022 / q-ptp-037 / q-ptp-020 taught the recovery position for an unconscious-but-breathing CRASH victim without qualification. ERC First Aid restricts it to decreased responsiveness 'due to medical illness or non-physical trauma' and says outright that after trauma moving the person may not be appropriate. Keys KEPT (of the four offered positions the side-lying one is still the right pick, and Bulgarian driver training teaches it), explanations now carry the trauma caveat. Flagged for the founder — this is a curriculum question, not an arithmetic one.

q-ptp-062 marks limb elevation as an action that 'помага' against life-threatening bleeding. ERC First Aid 2021 found no comparative evidence for elevation, pressure points or cryotherapy. Key KEPT (flipping it on 'no evidence found' would be overreach and would risk the real exam), explanation now states the honest hierarchy: pressure is what works, elevation is traditional and harmless but does not replace it. Flagged for the founder.

БЧК's public first-aid page (redcross.bg/activities/activities4/first_help, fetched 2026-08-03) still states 'гръдната кост при всеки натиск трябва да хлътва с 4-5 см' — the pre-2010 depth, superseded by ERC. It agrees with us on 30:2, direct pressure and the recovery position. CONCLUSION: cite ERC for the numbers; БЧК is usable as a Bulgarian-language reference but is stale on compression depth and states no rate at all. This is why the block was grounded against ERC and not against БЧК.
stillUngrounded: q-ptp-056 — the head-tilt/chin-lift manoeuvre name. Present in the ERC BLS step-by-step (Fig. 3), which is a raster figure; not extractable as text from either PDF, and not stated in the prose of either document. The explanation now leads with what IS retrievable (the ERC trigger for starting CPR) and presents the manoeuvre as standard first-aid technique rather than as a quoted ERC line.

q-ptp-057 — the ~10-second breathing check. Same situation: it lives in the BLS algorithm figure. The only '10 seconds' in the retrieved First Aid text is about rinsing an avulsed tooth. Under ADR-002 it is not written as an ERC quote. These two are the only first-aid claims in the block still without a verbatim source quote — and wave 3's own note asserted both as 'consistent with ЗДвП/ERC', which was recall, not retrieval.

q-ptp-019 (impaled object) and q-ptp-034 (nothing by mouth after trauma) are not covered as discrete recommendations in ERC 2021 First Aid. Both explanations now say so plainly instead of borrowing the guideline's authority.
Helmet removal (q-ptp-020) is not addressed in ERC 2021 First Aid. The cervical-spine recommendations grounding the answer are; the helmet step itself is not.
wave4.schemaGap: There is no way to express any of the above IN the data. LawRefSchema is z.strictObject({act, ref}) and QuestionSchema is strict too, so a `sourceRef` naming a medical guideline cannot be added without a schema change (platform/src/lib/content/types.ts + schemas.ts + validate-content.mjs in lockstep, and the review console's citation lookup). Until then the medical citation lives in explanationBg prose, where no validator can check it and the review console cannot resolve it. This is the honest state, not the desired one. See docs/education/90 §12 item 8 ('notLaw' marker).

wave5.finding: Wave 4 closed with a schemaGap: a medical citation could not be expressed in the data, so it lived in explanationBg prose 'where no validator can check it'. That gap was subsequently closed from both ends — content/SCHEMA.md gained `sourceRefs` ({sourceId, ref, claimId}, with lawRefs.length + sourceRefs.length >= 1), content/medical/ gained a register of quotes cut from fetched guidelines, and lib/content/sources gained claimsForQuestion(). AND THE TWO ENDS WERE NEVER JOINED. Measured at HEAD before this wave: the register named 28 of these rows across 35 (question, claim) pairs and NOT ONE row carried a sourceRefs entry; 2 of 1,089 questions in the entire bank had one at all (q-ptp-044, q-ptp-058). So claims.json stated 'ERC 2025 says 5-6 cm' while q-ptp-036 still offered retrieval nothing but ЗДвП чл. 123. Under ADR-002 the tutor grounds on what the ROW cites, so the Tier C defect was fully intact behind a directory that made it look closed — arguably worse than the original, because it now looked fixed to anyone who opened the register.
wave5.whatChangedPerRow: ONE field on each of the 29: sourceRefs, inserted between lawRefs and media. No stem, no option, no explanation, no answer key, no status, no lawRef was touched — the diff is 91 inserted lines and zero modified ones. The pairing was derived from content/medical/claims.json rather than chosen by hand, so no citation on any row is an editorial judgement about what a guideline says.

Six rows had no claim at all and were teaching clinical content on prose alone: q-ptp-056 (airway opening), -057 (10-second breathing check), -059 (AED), -061 (shock), -019 (impaled object), plus -014/-015/-033/-034/-035, which sat only under med-legal-duty — a claim whose every quote is ЗДвП. New claims: med-airway-opening, med-aed-use, med-shock-recognition, med-responsiveness-check, med-call-early, med-triage-unresponsive-first, med-nothing-by-mouth, med-impaled-object. med-breathing-check gained q-ptp-057 (the only row whose answer IS its figure) and med-shock-recognition gained q-ptp-035.
wave5.wave4CorrectionOnEvidence: Wave 4 recorded q-ptp-056's head-tilt/chin-lift and the ~10-second breathing check as unreachable — 'present in the ERC BLS step-by-step (Fig. 3), which is a raster figure; not extractable as text'. That was true of the ERC 2021 PDFs wave 4 held. It is NOT true of the ERC 2025 layperson edition now in the register: both are prose, at erc2025_layperson.txt:785 and :791-792, and both are now cut by locator like any other quote. The gap was a property of the source that wave had, not of the claim.
wave5.quotesCheckedNotAssumed: Three quotes that shipped in explanations were probed against the retrieved text and initially MISSED: 'Prevent hypothermia - remove wet clothes...', the AVPU 'responds to pain on squeezing their shoulder', and ERC's 'talk to them calmly'. All three are REAL; the PDF extraction splits a drop-cap from its word ('n P revent') and wraps sentences across lines. Locators were written to match the line that actually exists rather than the sentence a reader would type — a locator 'corrected' to the pretty form fails the build with LOCATOR MISS, which is the intended behaviour. No fabricated quotation was found in any of the 29.
wave5.stillUngrounded: Five of the 21 claims are ungrounded-*, up from two, because the register was extended to rows it had been silent about. med-impaled-object carries ZERO quotes by construction (an exhaustive sweep of all eight sources for impaled/embedded/foreign object/penetrating returns nothing), which is what makes the status falsifiable: build-claims.mjs refuses to emit ungrounded-no-reachable-source on a claim carrying any quote. med-triage-unresponsive-first and med-nothing-by-mouth are inferred-only. med-extrication-technique and med-helmet-removal are unchanged. Every one of these is already disclosed to the student in the explanation itself.
wave5.humanGate: STATUS WAS NOT TOUCHED AND MUST NOT BE BY A GENERATOR. content/SCHEMA.md rule 0b: 'Never write status: approved — that word is a person's.' isExamEligible and isLessonEligible both key on that exact string, so the two remaining red tests (exam/content-bank REVIEW_DEBT at 31/64, lesson/compose 'l-accidents-first-aid has no quiz beat') clear when a human signs at /review and not before, exactly as docs/education/90 §14.7 predicted. Measured: REVIEW_DEBT needs ONE signature (32/64 = 0.50 is not below MIN_APPROVED_SHARE 0.5); the lesson needs at least one approved row in each of c-first-aid-priorities, c-cpr-basics, c-bleeding-control and c-victim-handling, all four of which stand at zero approved and hold only these 29.
